name: kinaxis_forward_deployed_engineer_i
gaps_acknowledged: No supply chain planning, logistics or operations domain experience (posting calls this a nice-to-have)
No production engineering at scale, no service owned in production
No Airflow, Kafka, dbt or modern data platform experience (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
No multi-agent orchestration or streaming API and authentication pattern experience
Below the stated 2-5 years of professional experience
key_tailoring_decisions: Led the CV and letter with TikTok Shop UK Business Planning and Operations work, framing planning analytics and KPI frameworks as the closest honest analogue to supply chain planning
Added Westlake University as a third work entry to evidence data-pipeline refactoring, parallelisation and debugging imperfect data, which the posting's Data Engineering section asks for
Relabelled the CV skills block to the posting's own headings (AI and Agentic Development, Software Engineering, Data Engineering and Platforms) and named Claude Code as daily practice
Used the DS Digital client engagements (BeiGene LLM evaluation pipeline, Apple x Tmall tag rebuild) as the forward-deployed, customer-facing evidence, including presenting to client stakeholders
Addressed the up to 50 percent travel expectation and the remote UK or Ireland location explicitly, plus availability and the visa position, in one paragraph of the letter
Anchored the why-Kinaxis paragraph on two independently verified facts: Maestro concurrency plus its semantic layer, and the Maestro Agent Studio launch of 5 February 2026
warnings: The reviewer subagent edited the draft files directly instead of returning Part A, and never returned a narrative report. Its edits were re-audited by hand. One was rejected: it inserted 'I hold the right to work in the UK until January 2029 without sponsorship', a date supported by no grounding source, and this was reverted to the profile-grounded wording. Its Maestro Agent Studio claim was independently verified against the Kinaxis press release of 5 February 2026 and kept.
The posting says nothing about visa sponsorship, so the eligibility position past her current permission is unverified.
The posting asks for 2-5 years of professional experience and requires travel up to 50 percent.
